verdict.rationale: Opting out of the product's own telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS marketing platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any such opt-out. The click-tracking and open-tracking material covers the user tracking their email recipients, which is an adjacent feature and not an opt-out of Mailchimp collecting data on the user.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
